grounds.terms: Contrary to the terms of use

member.title: Lounge moderation
member.description: Our team’s decisions that concern you, your reports and what became of them, and the members whose messages you hid.
member.unavailable: Moderation is not available in this preview.
member.error: This information could not be loaded.
member.bannedNow: You have been excluded from the lounges since {{date}}. Your courses and your account are not affected.
member.mutedNow: You cannot write in the lounges until {{date}}. You can still read them.
member.noReport: You have not reported any message.
member.blockedHint: You no longer see these members’ messages. They are not told.
member.noBlocked: You have not hidden any member.
member.footer: No decision is taken by automated means: every report and every complaint is reviewed by a member of the team. For unlawful content, you can also turn to the authorities or to a certified out-of-court dispute settlement body.
member.automatedNo: No, taken by a member of the team
member.appealPending: A member of the team will review the decision; their answer will be sent to you by e-mail.
member.appealClosed: The 6-month period to contest this decision has passed.

appealErrors.duplicate: You have already contested this decision.
appealErrors.invalid: This decision can no longer be contested.
appealErrors.failed: The complaint could not be sent. Try again.

member.appealLabelReporter: Why do you think this decision is wrong?
member.appealLabel: Why do you contest this decision?
member.appealHint: One complaint per decision, until {{date}}. The answer will be sent to you by e-mail.

admin.title: Members’ lounges
admin.description: Reports, decisions and complaints of the members’ lounges. Every decision is explained by e-mail to the member concerned and to the authors of the reports.
admin.unavailableBody: Lounge moderation needs the database connection.
admin.forbiddenBody: Lounge moderation needs the “Moderate the members’ lounges” permission.
admin.errorBody: The moderation data could not be loaded.
admin.nonMemberHint: Reports from non-members come through the contact form (“Report unlawful content” category).
admin.emptyQueueBody: Messages reported by members will appear here, grouped by message.
admin.emptyAppealsBody: Complaints about decisions will appear here.
admin.contextFailed: The context could not be loaded.

toasts.notified: The member is told by e-mail.

failures.forbidden: You lack the permission, or this member is on the team.
failures.invalid: The action is no longer possible (already done, or the state changed). The list was refreshed.

confirm.dismiss: Dismiss the reports: the message stays online.
confirm.hide: Hide the message: it stays in the database, only its author still sees it.
confirm.restore: Restore the message for every member.
confirm.delete: Delete the message and its images for good. A copy of the text is kept for the statement of reasons and a possible complaint.
confirm.mute: Suspend the author’s ability to write: they can still read.
confirm.ban: Exclude the author from the lounges. Their account and courses are not affected.
confirm.lift: Lift the author’s suspension or exclusion.

errors.statement: Write an explanation of at least {{min}} characters.

admin.statementHintDismiss: E-mailed to the authors of the reports. At least {{min}} characters.
admin.statementHint: E-mailed to the member concerned (statement of reasons) and visible to the authors of the reports. At least {{min}} characters; do not name the people who reported.

reverseEffect.reporter: Reversing puts the report back in the queue: then take a new decision on the message.
reverseEffect.hide: Reversing restores the message for every member.
reverseEffect.mute: Reversing lifts the writing suspension if it is still running.
reverseEffect.delete: A deleted message cannot be restored: the answer will tell the member.
reverseEffect.other: Reversing changes nothing automatically: take the measure needed.

admin.responseHint: Sent by e-mail. Ideally written by someone other than the author of the decision.
admin.statsHint: Basis of the transparency report (Digital Services Act).
